modifications: The upstream source tree is unchanged. Separate launchers select the GUI/remote-command or picard-cli entry point, initialize the profile, and omit source text from tracebacks. A separate process guard confines writes to profile/document directories and restricts child executables; upstream files remain unchanged.
configuration: XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME are below DATA_DIR; first-run wizard and tutorial prompts are completed. The GUI starts with --no-plugins and update checks disabled.

notes.requirements_source: The upstream source release requirements.txt; pinned in environment/base-requirements.txt.
notes.process_isolation: process_guard.c is compiled at installation; requires Linux Landlock. Native helper execution is limited to the installed runtime; Python applications cannot launch external executables.
